title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Order Intake Rule: One Open Calibration Order per Source
content:
## Rule

One glass job, insurance claim repair, customer-pay repair or warranty rework may have at most the tier's maximum of open calibration orders per source — 1 on every ADAS Sensor Calibrations tier — open at once, where **open** means opened, prechecked, in calibration or sublet.

**Condition for opening an order.** A calibration order is opened for a source only where the source has no other open calibration order.

**Several systems on one source.** When the source needs more than one system calibrated, a single Multi-System Calibration order covers them all. When a further system is found after an order opened, the open order is cancelled and one Multi-System Calibration order replaces it.

## What the condition is judged on

- **Authority.** The condition is judged from the network's own records of calibration orders, read before the order is opened — not from the customer's account of what is or is not open.
- **Same source.** The orders compared are those recorded against the same source: the same glass job, the same insurance claim repair order, the same customer-pay repair order or the same warranty rework authorization as the order to be opened.
- **Status.** Only an order whose status is opened, prechecked, in calibration or sublet counts as open.

## Order status and the limit

| Status of an existing order on the same source | Counts as open |
|---|---|
| opened | yes |
| prechecked | yes |
| in calibration | yes |
| sublet | yes |
| completed | no |
| declined | no |
| cancelled | no |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. An insurance claim repair already has a calibration order in sublet status. That order is open, so the repair has another open calibration order and a second order is not opened for it.
2. A glass job's earlier calibration order was cancelled. A cancelled order is not open, so the glass job has no other open calibration order and an order may be opened for it.
3. A customer-pay repair needs both its forward camera and its front radar calibrated. One Multi-System Calibration order covers both systems; two single-system orders are not opened.
4. After a Static Camera Calibration order opened on a warranty rework, a blind spot radar is also found to need calibration. The open Static Camera Calibration order is cancelled and one Multi-System Calibration order replaces it.
